```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(Hmisc)
library(car)
library(rstatix)
library(gt)
library(webshot2)
library(broom)

DATA<-"D:/01_Uni/Thesis/BUILD/Data/"
RESULT<-"D:/01_Uni/Thesis/BUILD/Result/"

BuildDataPath <- function (local_filepath)
{
  paste(DATA,local_filepath, sep = "")
}

CopyFileToResult <- function (filename)
{
  file.copy(filename, file.path(RESULT, filename), overwrite = TRUE)
}

#Load experiment variables
variablesGpu <- data.table::fread(BuildDataPath("GPU/variables.csv"),fill = TRUE)
variablesCpu <- data.table::fread(BuildDataPath("CPU/variables.csv"),fill = TRUE)
variablesDirect <- data.table::fread(BuildDataPath("Direct/variables.csv"),fill = TRUE)

#Load experiment data
frameTimeGpu <- data.table::fread(BuildDataPath("GPU/forceCalcTime.csv"), sep = ";")
frameTimeCpu <- data.table::fread(BuildDataPath("CPU/forceCalcTime.csv"), sep = ";")
frameTimeDirect <- data.table::fread(BuildDataPath("Direct/forceCalcTime.csv"), sep = ";")
  
##Check if variables are identical besides method
variablesOk <- identical(variablesGpu[-1], variablesCpu[-1]) && identical(variablesGpu[-1], variablesDirect[-1]) &&
  variablesGpu[[2]][1] == 2 &&
  variablesCpu[[2]][1] == 1 &&
  variablesDirect[[2]][1] == 0

rowCount <- variablesGpu[[2]][9]
nCount <- variablesGpu[[2]][3] + 1

frameTime <- data.table(step = 1:rowCount)

frameTime[, gpu := frameTimeGpu[[1]][1:rowCount]]
frameTime[, cpu := frameTimeCpu[[1]][1:rowCount]]
frameTime[, direct := frameTimeDirect[[1]][1:rowCount]]

frameTimeLong <- melt (frameTime, id.vars = "step"
                       , measure.vars = c("gpu", "cpu", "direct")
                       , variable.name = "method"
                       , value.name = "time")
```

## Experiment Variables
```{r include=FALSE}
  experimentVar<-variablesGpu[-1]
  setnames(experimentVar, 1, "Variable Name")
  setnames(experimentVar, 2, "V1")
  setnames(experimentVar, 3, "V2")
  gt_table <- gt(experimentVar) %>%
    tab_header(title="Control-Variables") %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
    fmt_number(rows = 3, decimals = 5) %>%
    fmt_number(rows = c(2,8,9), decimals = 0) %>%
    fmt_number(rows = c(1,4,5,6,7,10,11,12), decimals = 2)
  
  gtsave(gt_table, "control_variables.png")
  CopyFileToResult ("control_variables.png")
```
![](control_variables.png)
\newpage

## Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
```{r echo=FALSE}
  plot <- ggplot(frameTimeLong) +
    aes(sample = time, color = method) +
    stat_qq() +
    stat_qq_line() +
    facet_wrap(~method, scales = "free") +
    labs(color = "Method", y = "MS", x ="Method") +
    ggtitle(sprintf("QQ-Plots per method n = %d", nCount)) +
    theme_minimal()

  ggsave(filename = "qq.png", plot = plot, width = 10, dpi=600)
  CopyFileToResult ("qq.png")
```

```{r include=FALSE}
  shapiroTable <- frameTimeLong[, .(W = shapiro.test(time)$statistic, p_value = shapiro.test(time)$p.value), by = method]
  gt_table <- gt(shapiroTable) %>%
    tab_header(title="Shapiro-Wilk-Test") %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
    cols_label(method="Method")
  
  gtsave(gt_table, "shapiro_test.png")
  CopyFileToResult ("shapiro_test.png")
```
![](shapiro_test.png)
\newpage

## Levene test of homogeneity of variances
```{r echo=FALSE}
  plot <- ggplot(frameTimeLong) +
    aes(x = method, y = time, fill = method) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(alpha = 0.2, width = 0.1, size = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~method, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(fill = "Method", y = "MS", x ="Method") +
    ggtitle(sprintf("Box-Plots per method n = %d", nCount)) +
    theme_minimal()

  ggsave(filename = "box.png", plot = plot, width = 10, dpi=600)
  CopyFileToResult ("box.png")
```

```{r include=FALSE}
  levTest <- leveneTest(time ~ method, data = frameTimeLong)
  levTestTidy <- tidy(levTest)  
  
  gt_table <- gt(levTestTidy) %>%
    tab_header(title="Levene-Test") %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),locations = cells_column_labels(everything()))
    
  gtsave(gt_table, "levene_test.png")
  CopyFileToResult ("levene_test.png")
```
![](levene_test.png)
\newpage

## Welch's ANOVA test of significance
```{r echo=FALSE}
 plot <- ggplot (frameTimeLong) +
    aes(x = method, y = time, color = method) +
    geom_jitter(alpha = 0.3, width = 0.5) +
    scale_y_log10(breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 10)) +
    labs(color = "Method", y = "MS", x ="Method") +
    ggtitle(sprintf("Force calculation time comparison n = %d", nCount)) +
    theme_minimal()+
    ##show mean per group
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", 
                 size = 3, color = "black", shape = 18)+
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, 
                 geom = "errorbar", 
                 width = 0.2, color = "black")

  ggsave(filename = "jitter.png", plot = plot, width = 10, dpi=600)
  CopyFileToResult ("jitter.png")
```

```{r include=FALSE}
  oneway.test(time ~ method, data = frameTimeLong, var.equal = FALSE)
  anova <- oneway.test(time ~ method, data = frameTimeLong, var.equal = FALSE)
  anovaTidy <- tidy(anova)  
  gt_table <- gt(anovaTidy) %>%
    tab_header(title="Welch-ANOVA-Test") %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),locations = cells_column_labels(everything()))
    
  gtsave(gt_table, "welch_anova_test.png")
  CopyFileToResult ("welch_anova_test.png")
```
![](welch_anova_test.png)
\newpage

## Post-Hoc Games Howell
```{r echo=FALSE}
  plot <- ggplot(frameTimeLong) +
    aes(x = step, y = time, color = method) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_y_log10(breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 10)) +
    labs(color = "Method", y = "MS", x = "Fixed Time Step") +
    ggtitle(sprintf("Force calculation time comparison n = %d", nCount)) +
    theme_minimal()

  ggsave(filename = "line.png", plot = plot, width = 10, dpi=600)
  CopyFileToResult ("line.png")
```
```{r include=FALSE}
  games_howell <- games_howell_test(time ~ method, data = frameTimeLong)
  gt_table <- gt(games_howell) %>%
    tab_header(title="Games-Howell-Test") %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),locations = cells_column_labels(everything()))
  
  gtsave(gt_table, "games_howell_test.png")
  CopyFileToResult ("games_howell_test.png")
```
![](games_howell_test.png)
